rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides AI agents with tools to manage secure enclaves (Trusted Execution Environments) through the Treza platform. Supports enclave attestation, payment processing, and cryptographic signing operations, enabling secure compute operations for autonomous agent workflows. Built on the Treza SDK with TypeScript and published as an npm package.
